analysis_result.analysis: The model’s core error lies in misordering the trajectory sequence: it assumed the arrow started at red, when ground truth confirms it started at orange. This flipped the entire path, causing the model to compare the wrong pair of distances. Additionally, instead of using precise positional data (as provided in ground truth) to compute Euclidean distances, the model relied on a flawed visual estimation of vertical movement, leading to an incorrect conclusion that orange was furthest from red — when in fact, green was furthest from red (4.65 > 4.36). The mislabeling of the orange shape as a 'circle' further indicates grounding inaccuracies that compounded the error.
